purpose: Model public and publicly documented research funding as flows connecting funders, programmes, grants, recipients, topics, institutions and outputs.

entity.scope: publicly documented research grants, programmes and major funding instruments

evidence_model.rule: Award amount must be distinguished from total programme budget, maximum eligible amount and actual expenditure.

validation_rules: amount requires currency and award context
award date is not necessarily payment date
planned funding is not awarded funding
co-funding must not be counted twice

implementation_notes.canonical_owner: An award owns grant-specific facts; funders, institutions, companies, people and publications remain separate nodes.
implementation_notes.frontend: Show funding chain and research outputs, not merely a grant title.
known_traps: programme budgets are mistaken for individual awards
implementation_notes.research_task: Start with European public research funding that crosses borders or links strategic technology, energy, health or infrastructure research.
